entries.result: A criminal has escaped from the institution. Roll a secondary Case.
You realize you are being followed. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
You are approached by a stranger who “advises” you to stop the Investigation. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
Someone threatens you. Mark one Instability, return this card to the pile and shuffle.

While walking down the street, a stranger attacks you and quickly flees. Mark one Wound. If you wish to try and catch them, roll ‘Hot Pursuit’ with Disadvantage. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
You are accused of a crime you did not commit. Treat this situation as a secondary Case.
You discover that your home/office/hotel room has been broken into and ransacked, resulting in the theft/destruction of 1d6 collected Clues. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
Hostile individuals raid the Location you’re currently investigating. Roll ‘Leave Without a Trace’ to avoid getting caught. Return this card to the pile and shuffle.
You are kidnapped and taken into captivity beyond the Town limits, where you are left alone. Mark two Instabilities, and increase the Time Limit by two.
When you open the door of your home/office/hotel room, you get shot at point-blank. Mark two Wounds.
You discover that a friend is being held in false imprisonment at a place beyond the Town limits. Mark one Instability.
A loved one has been kidnapped. Mark two Instabilities.
Your doppelgänger showed up! Roll ‘Face Doppelgänger’.
